content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents to identify all available project documents, then read candidate_specs.md. Extract the three allowed radiator candidates and record any numeric candidate identifiers and their documented properties relevant to selection, including refractive index, nominal transparency or attenuation length, allowed/typical thickness range if given, and humidity-ageing transparency loss values."},{"id":"s2","description":"Read the simulation/performance documentation for pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c. For each of the three candidates, extract or compute from the documented simulation results the pion/kaon separation as a function of radiator thickness over the allowed 1–6 cm range; record the numeric separation values and corresponding thicknesses."},{"id":"s3","description":"Apply the hard constraints numerically: exclude any candidate/thickness option with pion/kaon separation below 3.5 sigma, humidity-ageing transparency loss above 10%, or thickness outside 1–6 cm. Record pass/fail as numeric flags and record the best valid separation achieved by each candidate."},{"id":"s4","description":"Among the candidates that pass all hard constraints, identify the radiator material and thickness giving the maximum pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c. If multiple options are effectively tied, prefer the one with lower ageing transparency loss and then thinner radiator thickness. Record the recommended candidate identifier, thickness, predicted separation, and ageing transparency loss."},{"id":"s5","description":"Read any design notes, risk notes, or integration documents relevant to the chosen radiator to check for additional documented caveats such as handling, availability, mechanical compatibility, or known ageing concerns. Record any numeric risk or compatibility indicators available so the reporting module can include them in the final recommendation."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Radiator-R2","thickness_cm":6,"justification":"No fully compliant radiator can be verified from the recorded results because the required 10 GeV/c pion/kaon separation data were not found for any candidate. Among the candidates, R3 is disqualified by the hard humidity-ageing requirement with 40% transparency loss. R1 and R2 both satisfy the humidity limit and thickness feasibility, but neither has verified separation. If forced to submit one design, R2 at the maximum allowed thickness of 6 cm is the least-risk provisional choice because it has the lowest measured humidity loss among candidates that pass ageing; using the maximum allowed thickness is the most favorable choice for photon yield and hence separation. This recommendation must be treated as provisional/non-compliant until simulation or measurement confirms at least 3.5 sigma pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"Recorded candidate_count=3 and submitted option is Radiator-R2, corresponding to candidate_R2_id=2."},{"requirement":"Pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c must be at least 3.5 sigma.","status":"unknown","evidence":"No simulation performance document or separation values were found: simulation_performance_doc_found=0, separation_values_extracted_count=0, separation_data_available_R2=0, separation_constraint_verified_pass_R2=0."},{"requirement":"Transparency loss after 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.","status":"met","evidence":"R2 humidity ageing transparency loss is 3%, with humidity_pass_R2=1, below the 10% maximum."},{"requirement":"Radiator thickness must be between 1 and 6 cm.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted thickness is 6 cm; allowed_thickness_min_cm=1, allowed_thickness_max_cm=6, and thickness_range_feasible_R2=1."},{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.","status":"unknown","evidence":"Best valid separation could not be established for any candidate; best_valid_separation_R1_sigma=0, best_valid_separation_R2_sigma=0, best_valid_separation_R3_sigma=0 due to unavailable separation data.
